news.title: Owned Item Tracking
news.text:
You can now track which items you own in the Atomic Shop!
Mark items as owned to easily see which items, bundles, or partial bundles you already have.

Manage your owned items in the Database Browser via the 'Item Tracking' button (top right), or mark items directly using the '☐ Owned' checkbox.

Owned items should sync automatically, but if they don’t update right away, you can use the import button at the bottom of the website.
(Do not forget to export your owned items before clearing your browser cache or just in case!)
